يستوقون (form X)
# يَسْتَوْقُونَ (yastawqūna) /jas.taw.quː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَوْقَى (istawqā)
# يُسْتَوْقَوْنَ (yustawqawna) /jus.taw.qaw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَوْقَى (istawqā)
